notes: COMMON-NAME GUARD APPLIED as briefed: 'Dr. Arif Khan' is a common name, so I required AIG + medical oncology explicitly before accepting anything. Both matched. His full published name is 'Dr. Arif Mohammed Khan' (Practo/Skedoc render it 'Dr. Arif Mohammed Khan. S'); the source row's 'Dr. Arif Khan' is the short form. Identity confirmed on FOUR criteria - name + specialty (Medical Oncology) + hospital (AIG Hospitals) + city/branch (Gachibowli, Hyderabad) - by an AIG-owned page titled 'Dr. Arif Mohammed Khan | Medical & Hemato-Oncologist at AIG Hospitals, Hyderabad', corroborated by Practo ('Medical Oncologist in Gachibowli, Hyderabad'), Skedoc, Credihealth and myUpchar (which files him under Gachibowli/Oncology). A US oncologist 'Dr. Mohammad M. Khan, Hagerstown MD' also surfaced and was explicitly rejected - wrong country, wrong hospital, no AIG link. URL PROVENANCE CAVEAT - please read: the AIG doctor page surfaced ONLY through AIG's Google-translate locale mirror (aighospitals-com.translate.goog/doctor/dr-arif-mohammed-khan). Per rule 2 I recorded that URL exactly as returned and did NOT rewrite it to the canonical aighospitals.com form, even though the pattern is obvious - the canonical never appeared verbatim in any of my three queries. A human can simply drop the translate wrapper to reach the live page. Separately, aighospitals.com/doctors/arif-mohammed-khan/ was returned as an explicit '404 Page Not Found' - that is the WRONG pattern (plural /doctors/, no dr- prefix) and is not evidence he lacks a page. BAND = Medium, honestly: AIG is the single official source (all AIG domains and locale mirrors count once); Practo, Skedoc, Credihealth, ZenOnco, myUpchar, Healthtrip and HealthCoco are corroborating-only and can never earn High. No healinindia.gov.in listing exists for him (I checked with a domain-filtered query), so no independent official source is available. No email, phone, LinkedIn, personal website or clinic site is published anywhere for him - those fields are blank rather than guessed.
